The drug is linked to the 5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 2B, which is a target of PF-03187207, and PF-03187207 is a target of the same subunit gamma. Additionally, darifenacin is also associated with the Proteasome subunit beta type-5, which is a target of bethanechol, and bethanechol is also a target of the same subunit gamma. These pathways indicate that darifenacin may influence the activity of the cGMP 3',5'-cyclic phosphodiesterase subunit gamma through different molecular mechanisms, possibly involving the modulation of neurotransmitter signaling and proteasome function. The evidence is consistent across multiple paths, suggesting a potential role for darifenacin in the regulation of this enzyme, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated.
